features: Live radio, podcasts and LibriVox audiobooks from OndaCast in one calm player
Subscribe to shows; new episodes land in Listen now, with play next and a queue
Speed remembered per show or book, and a sleep timer by minutes or end of chapter
Transcripts that follow along, audiobook chapters and bookmarks
Clip the last 30 seconds, with its transcript, to TEND Notes
Progress follows you across devices; a compact player when the window is narrow
requirements: A Tend panel that provides the ondacast capability
TEND Notes installed with a notebook, to save clips (optional)
release_notes: 1.0.0: First release. Radio, podcasts and audiobooks from OndaCast with subscriptions, a queue, per-show speed, sleep timer, transcripts, bookmarks and Clip to Notes.
